## ENIGMA personalized AI & applications

- Private Daily Check-in Planner: https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/blob/main/docs/personal-daily-checkin-demo.html

- This is an ENIGMA-only project and does not use the owner's separate tax, audit or accounting career or clients.
- Browser-local prototype, not an LLM or diagnostic medical tool. The demo can be tried without signup on the current verified HTTPS preview listed at docs/TEMP_PREVIEW.md.

## Available starting quotes (USD equivalent, not an automatic payment request)

- $5: up to 100 rows / 20 columns, clean CSV plus concise data-quality report.
- $15: one BTC mainnet public TXID output/amount evidence report.
- $25: one customized private browser daily check-in page, up to five agreed non-sensitive fields, source and notes; refer to working demo and tests.
- $30: customized read-only Bitcoin payment-request wallet for a merchant, with local invoice evidence report.
- $50: up to 500 BTC/Base-native-USDC CSV transaction-export rows reconciled to an approved general-ledger CSV with exception schedule.

**Exact network, address, satoshis, deadlines and objective acceptance criteria must be agreed with a real client first.** Read service JSON for limitations, original sample source and test runs.

All listings require mutually agreed scope, acceptance and payment terms; see the machine-readable catalogue for limitations.

## What an agent or buyer sends to request work

One non-sensitive request stating the task, desired output, sample CSV schema or public TXID, number of rows, test/acceptance criteria, actual authorized budget, preferred native Bitcoin-mainnet route and requested delivery date. Do not post private ledger records, API keys, credentials, wallet seeds or customer identity. No Gmail or email contact is used.

This is a discovery/quotation page, **not** an x402 endpoint, MCP or Nostr signer, invoice checkout, automatic paywall, escrow, guarantee of delivery, confirmed contract or a paid order. It does not pretend that the 750,377,265,360 configured role IDs are concurrently executing autonomous models.

Historical address observations are not proof of wallet ownership, merchant payments, newly earned income or the state of other networks.
